name.en: Rails, splices, clamps and accessories (roof catalogue)
name.es: Perfiles de riel, empalmes, garras y accesorios (catálogo de cubierta)

description.en: Shared catalogue of rail profiles, splices, clamps, gaskets and cable clips for roof mounts. Each sourced datum is held in its owning family file (ADR-0012); this file holds only the catalogue entries no family file owns and points to the owner for the rest.
description.es: Catálogo común de perfiles de riel, empalmes, garras, juntas y clips de cable para soportes de cubierta. Cada dato sourced se guarda en el archivo de su familia (ADR-0012); este archivo solo contiene entradas del catálogo que no pertenecen a una familia y remite al propietario en el resto.

typical_use: Bill of materials and modelling for roof rails and accessories across families.
applicable_standards: DIN 6923 (flange nut, cited by K2 catalogue, not read)
ISO 4762 (socket screw, cited by K2 catalogue, not read)

materials.material: EN AW-6063 T66 (K2 rails); EN AW 6082 T6 (K2 DomeClamp middle clamp). EN AW-6005-T5 not found.
EPDM (earlier K2 research; hardness not stated)

profiles.name: K2 MultiRail 10, 15, 25 (short rail segments of 100, 150 and 250 mm)

geometry.description: Catalogue only; no placement. Rail cross-sections not found.

accessories.name: K2 DomeClamp middle clamp 30-50
accessories.material: EN AW 6082 T6 (clamp body); T-bolt 1.4301 listed for the product
accessories.note: Frame range 30 to 50 mm from the product name only, not confirmed on the page body. Torque not stated.

accessories.name: EPDM sealing gasket or washer (fastener and rail seals)
accessories.purpose: Seals fasteners against the roof covering
accessories.note: From earlier K2 research (roof_structures.md section 3); not re-checked in this pass.

accessories.name: Cable clip (generic, module and rail cables)
accessories.purpose: Holds module cables to the rail
accessories.note: No sourced cable clip in roof families. K2 BasicClip is a bracket (roof_trapezoidal_sheet_rail).

accessories.name: Bonding clip (generic)
accessories.note: Sourced grounding data is held in roof_trapezoidal_sheet_rail (K2 TerraGrif) and roof_pitched_rafter_rail (IronRidge lug). This entry is a placeholder.
